title: Select all
code: SELECT * FROM students;
description: Read every column from the sample students table.
explanation: Read every column from the sample students table.
usage: Use this when you need to read every column from the sample students table.

id | name   | score | course_id
1  | Alex   | 92    | 1
2  | Sam    | 88    | 1
3  | Jordan | 58    | 2
